title: Hedging out the HEDGE Bias: Identifying Dynamic Partial-Equilibrium Effects with Panel LP-IV
abstract: arXiv:2611.14434v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Cross-sectional designs are widely used to estimate dynamic partial-equilibrium effects of an aggregate treatment. We show analytically that these estimates are biased when exposures to the treatment and to aggregate confounders are correlated or the confounders feed back into the treatment. This paper develops the heterogeneous-exposure local-projection instrumental variables (HELP-IV) framework, which compares units while holding the confounder path fixed by instrumenting the treatment and this path with exposure-weighted shock proxies. We prove that HELP-IV identifies the partial-equilibrium effect. We further extend the framework, with the corresponding inference, to multiple exposure margins and confounders, forward-looking outcomes, and cumulative multipliers. translated_title: 对冲消除HEDGE偏差：利用面板局部投影工具变量法识别动态局部均衡效应
translated_abstract: 横截面设计被广泛用于估计总体处理的动态局部均衡效应。我们从理论上证明，当处理暴露与总体混杂因素的暴露相关，或混杂因素会反馈到处理中时，这些估计是有偏的。本文提出了异质暴露局部投影工具变量（HELP-IV）框架，该框架通过用暴露加权的冲击代理变量对处理和混杂因素路径进行工具变量化，在固定混杂因素路径的前提下对个体单元进行比较。我们证明HELP-IV能够识别局部均衡效应。我们进一步将该框架及其相应的统计推断扩展到多重暴露边际与混杂因素、前瞻性结果以及累积乘数的情形。最后，我们将HELP-IV应用于州财政乘数和区域股票财富效应的研究，所得到的局部均衡效应小于传统方法的估计值。
tldr: 本文提出HELP-IV框架，通过暴露加权冲击代理变量构造工具变量，在固定混杂因素路径的条件下识别总体处理的动态局部均衡效应，证明了传统横截面估计存在偏差，并应用于财政乘数与股票财富效应研究。
en_tdlr: This paper develops the HELP-IV framework, which identifies dynamic partial-equilibrium effects of aggregate treatments by instrumenting the treatment and confounder path with exposure-weighted shock proxies, proving that conventional cross-sectional estimates are biased and demonstrating smaller effects in fiscal multiplier and stock-wealth applications.
